description: Fill multiple form fields (inputs, selects, checkboxes, textareas) and optionally submit in a single tool call. Compatible with React Hook Form, Vue, and standard HTML5 forms. Supports inline post-fill waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

fields.description: List of fields to fill: [{selector: '@1' or '#id', value: 'my text', clear: true}]

value.description: Value to set (string, boolean for checkbox, etc.)

includeSnapshot.description: Capture and return an interactive page snapshot after filling form (default: false)

pressEnter.description: Press enter on the last input after filling (default: false)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after filling form

submitSelector.description: Optional selector or snapshot ref (e.g. '@4') of submit button to click after filling

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after filling form

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after filling form

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after filling form
